visual_action: Donald Trump and Keir Starmer are shown sitting at a table flanked by American and British flags. They sign documents, then hold them up for an audience, who applauds. The video concludes with a black-and-white graphic of the White House logo.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: On-screen text reads 'President Trump', and he is identified by face recognition.

cast.name: Keir Starmer
cast.evidence: On-screen text identifies him as 'U.K. Prime Minister Starmer'.

cast.name: The White House
cast.evidence: The video is posted by the @whitehouse account and ends with 'THE WHITE HOUSE' logo.

on_screen_text.text: President Trump & U.K. Prime Minister Starmer Sign Historic Tech Prosperity Deal

spoken_summary: There is no speech in the video. The only sounds are orchestral music and applause.
audio_music: A grand, patriotic orchestral track plays throughout the video. The sound of audience applause is audible after the signing.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, static shot of the signing event, which then cuts to a closing credit graphic.
cultural_references: The caption 'Art of the deal 😏' is a self-reference to Donald Trump's 1987 book 'The Art of the Deal'.
central_claim: President Trump and UK Prime Minister Keir Starmer have successfully signed a 'Historic Tech Prosperity Deal'.
intended_effect: To portray the Trump administration as effective in securing important international agreements and to evoke a sense of national pride.
